evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) and scripts under ci/test/ to execute native FreeBSD CI tests instead of cross-compilation.
rationale: Adds native build and test execution for FreeBSD in CI, catching platform-specific regressions before merge rather than in external nightly runs. Reviewers note that 'running tests properly in Core CI with reliable resources is preferable to dealing with noisy external nightly failures'.
